catalog_name: Accounting event and boundary acceptance cases
purpose: Self-contained financial reconstruction tests with fully stated journal events, expected balances, decimal arithmetic and explicit compatibility decisions
numeric_encoding: All monetary amounts, rates and measured quantities are decimal strings; counts and precision values are integers
account_binding: Account-role labels bind to configured leaf accounts within the stated company. Labels do not prescribe account numbers or physical database identifiers.
opening_balance_scope: Opening balances include only accounts needed by a case. Omitted accounts begin at zero for this local sequence; examples are not asserted to be a complete company opening trial balance.
closing_balance_sign: Positive means debit excess; negative means credit excess. These are ledger signs, not report display conventions.

execution_status.independent_exact_decimal_verification: all journal events balance; all declared closing balances and arithmetic assertions checked
execution_status.scope: Mathematical consistency and reconstruction acceptance inputs, not proof of complete operational deployment

assertion_operations.subtract: first operand less each subsequent operand
assertion_operations.divide: first operand divided by each subsequent operand
assertion_operations.multiply_divide: first operand multiplied by second operand, divided by third operand
assertion_operations.round: round the first operand to declared precision

assertion_rounding: When precision is supplied, round final expression to that many places using stated method or profile half away from zero; without precision compare exact decimal result
